stages.name: Consumer and producer surplus
stages.title: Consumer and producer surplus
stages.sub: You can identify consumer and producer surplus as areas on a supply and demand diagram.

steps.q: A concert ticket sells for £40. One fan would have paid up to £70 rather than miss out, but only pays £40. Did she value the ticket at exactly £40?
steps.right: No, she valued it more than £40
steps.wrong: Yes, she valued it at exactly £40
steps.hint: Think about the highest price she said she'd have paid, not the price she actually paid.

steps.wrong: Nothing, because she still had to pay £40

steps.q: On a supply and demand diagram, every point on the demand curve above the equilibrium price shows a buyer willing to pay more than they actually paid. What area, between the demand curve and the price line, captures all of those gains added together?
steps.right: The triangle above the price line and below the demand curve
steps.wrong: The triangle below the price line and above the supply curve
steps.hint: Consumer surplus comes from buyers, whose curve is demand.
